title: Directional derivatives of a locally Lipschitz function along a differentiable chart (Simon Ch. 2, 4.10)
statement: Let n, P ∈ ℕ, F : ℝ^P → ℝ, Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P and w ∈ ℝⁿ. Assume F is Lipschitz (with some constant K ≥ 0) on some neighbourhood V of Φ(w), Φ is differentiable at w and F∘Φ is differentiable at w. Then for every s ∈ ℝⁿ the function t ↦ F(Φ(w) + t·DΦ(w)s) has derivative D(F∘Φ)(w)s at t = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (F : Eucl P → ℝ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (w : Eucl n), (∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 (Φ w), LipschitzOnWith K F V) → DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ w → DifferentiableAt ℝ (F ∘ Φ) w → ∀ s : Eucl n, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => F (Φ w + t • fderiv ℝ Φ w s)) (fderiv ℝ (F ∘ Φ) w s) 0
